allocator_provenance: Both phases used the same task controller with empty per-command environment overrides and no allocator override. Original configurations did not record GLIBC_TUNABLES; this provenance, rather than configuration equality, establishes the intended allocator mode. Base and candidate within every pair inherited the identical environment.
method: Unadjusted paired bootstrap 95% intervals, same seeded median-ratio method as original harness; all phases retained.
